fato_historico: 2014: The Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant launches its Kobani offensive against Syrian–Kurdish forces.
energia_do_dia: Today the universe invites you to cultivate inner stability, dear Taurus. Like a persistent sprout emerging from challenging soil, you may find that challenges in the world mirror your own journey toward strength. Consider how your unwavering patience can help you navigate transitions, turning moments of tension into opportunities for grounded reflection and profound personal healing.
frase_do_dia: Quiet strength blooms beautifully even in the most unexpected and challenging landscapes.
significado_numero: Represents the path toward domestic harmony and building solid foundations.
conselho: Focus on nurturing your peace of mind and staying centered amidst external noise.
